GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is used to extract and organize details about a client's assets from their meeting discussions for record-keeping in Salesforce.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query involves asset details, extract the relevant information and organize it for Salesforce updates.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only extract and structure client asset details from meeting transcripts for record-keeping. You aren't responsible for verifying or analyzing the asset data.
